THE FOUR HIGHEST-VALUE FINDINGS, in order:
1. §8.5 parity budget clamp is UNWIRED (WIRE, v1 blocker). budget::parity_final / budget::budget_cap_permille (budget.rs:36-45) have ZERO callers outside crates/adaptive-transport/tests/tv_emergency.rs. sender.rs:3620 writes the arbiter output straight into d.fec_parity_ratio_permille with no BtlBw-derived or profile cap. The spec calls this NORMATİF ("dar bandı FEC israf etmez", specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md:658). The rate half of the same clause is half-wired too: sender.rs:4032 passes u64::MAX as the ceiling, so only the 31 B/s MIN_RATE floor is live. Given that FEC is now default-ON, this is the single most consequential gap in the module.
2. The shipped speculative config makes three of its own mechanisms degenerate. bounded_v1 sets bootstrap_cap_permille = persistent_cap_permille = 250 (sender.rs:438-439). Therefore, in the product default: (a) the L1/L2 escalation ladder (sender.rs:4334-4340) returns 250 in every arm — the level survives only in diag_spec_levels and TsSample.level_idx; (b) the DEADLINE_ASSISTED tight-budget branch changes no number, only the arbiter reason label; (c) the dc9bac04 handoff-cliff fix `cap = cap.min(bootstrap_cap_permille)` (sender.rs:4360) cannot lower anything. These are real mechanisms that are structurally inert in the configuration they ship with, and any claim that the shipped v1 "escalates parity on persistence" or "hands off to the canonical lane" is not supported by the shipped numbers.
3. Bench/product config divergence, self-documented but unfixed. crates/bench/src/kama_product.rs:187-192 builds `FecLossRiskConfig::experimental_v1()` (125/250, FixedSrtt, G1 OFF) or `default()` — never `bounded_v1()`. crates/client-core/src/runtime.rs:187-191 records this exact finding (B-5) and prescribes the remedy (bench must start from KamaV1Profile::runtime_config()), but the remedy is not applied. Consequence: the campaign numbers behind "FEC v1 closure" were produced with a different persistence mode and with the C4 G1 guard disabled relative to what ships.
4. Producer-without-consumer in the SR logical ledger (WIRE). record_confirmed_logical (sender.rs:2951) and record_recovered_logical (sender.rs:4842) push on every product ACK / RECOVERED, but take_confirmed_logical (sender.rs:4863) has ZERO product callers — the deque saturates CONFIRMED_LOGICAL_CAP=4096 and silently pop_front()s forever. Symmetrically, register_sent_logical (sender.rs:4759) has zero product callers, so in production only FEC parity emissions ever populate sent_logical and every DATA ACK falls into the unknown-seq branch bumping diag_confirmed_logical_miss (sender.rs:4743). The ledger is half-built on the shipping path.
